blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Molecular Biology (chapter banner printed as 'Biomolecules')) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, farq, structure ki tafseel, misalein), aik 4 number ka hissa ya 1+3 / 2+2 ke chhote hisson mein. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Organic molecules make up most of the dry mass of protoplasm. (i) What are organic molecules and functional groups? (ii) Explain macromolecules and polymers, giving the percentage of the major organic molecules in dry mass. (4 marks)
(Organic molecules protoplasm ke dry mass ka zyada hissa hain. (i) Organic molecules aur functional groups kya hain? (ii) Macromolecules aur polymers ki wazahat karein aur dry mass mein bare organic molecules ka feesad batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Organic molecules woh molecules hain jo cells banate hain aur jin mein carbon hai; yeh qudrati taur par sirf jaandaaron ya un ki paidawar aur baqiyat mein milte hain. In ka carbon core hota hai jis se atoms ke khaas groups, functional groups (OH, CO, COOH, NH₂), jure hain. Zyada tar biochemical reactions functional group ko aik molecule se doosre mein le jate hain ya carbon-carbon bond torte hain.

(ii) Zyada tar organic molecules bare hain aur macromolecules kehlate hain. Bohat se polymers hain: aik jaise units (monomers) se bane molecules. Carbohydrates, proteins aur nucleic acids tarteeb se sugars, amino acids aur nucleotides ke polymers hain.
Carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids dry mass ka 93% hain (Table 4.1): proteins 50%, nucleic acids 18%, carbohydrates 15%, lipids 10%. Baqi 7% chhote organic molecules (vitamins) aur inorganic molecules (CO₂, acids, bases, salts) hain.

book_ref.quote: Most of the organic molecules are large in size and biologists call them macromolecules

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe the types of bonds and interactions found in biological molecules and give the role of each. (4 marks)
(Biological molecules mein paye jane wale bonds aur interactions ki qismein aur har aik ka kirdar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Covalent bond: do atoms electrons share karte hain. Aksar proteins aur nucleic acids jaise organic molecules mein, unhein mazbooti deta hai.
2. Ionic bond: aik atom electron deta hai (cation banta hai) aur doosra leta hai (anion banta hai); mukhalif charge wale ions ki electrostatic kashish bond hai. Solid haalat mein nisbatan mazboot; zyada tar sodium chloride jaise inorganic molecules mein.
3. Hydrogen bond: hydrogen atom aur electronegative atom (oxygen ya nitrogen) ke darmiyan kamzor kashish. Proteins aur nucleic acids ki banawat qaim rakhta hai aur DNA replication jaise amal mein ahem hai.
4. Hydrophobic interactions: nonpolar molecules paani se bachne ke liye ikatthe ho jate hain. Protein folding aur membranes ki lipid bilayer ke liye zaroori.
5. Hydrophilic interactions: polar molecules aur paani ke darmiyan. Polar aur ionic compounds hal karne ke liye zaroori; ghiza ki muntaqili aur cell ke reactions mein madad.
Carbon khud tetravalent hai: is ka C-H bond chemical energy ka zariya, C-O glycosidic linkages carbohydrates ko mazboot aur C-N peptide bonds proteins banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Different types of bonds and interactions play vital roles in the structure and function of biological molecules

blocks.prompt:
3 Define hydrolysis. Explain how it is the reverse of condensation, using the example of maltose, and give its importance. (4 marks)
(Hydrolysis ki definition likhein. Maltose ki misaal se samjhayein ke yeh condensation ka ulat kaise hai, aur is ki ahmiyat batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hydrolysis: woh chemical amal jis mein paani ke molecules shamil kar ke macromolecule (polymer) ko chhote tukron mein tora jata hai.

Condensation (dehydration synthesis): monomers jur kar polymer banate hain; aik monomer se -OH aur doosre se -H hat-ta hai, yani paani ka molecule nikalta hai. Energy chahiye, is liye cells ko macromolecules banane ke liye energy deni parti hai. Misaal: do glucose jur kar maltose banate hain.

Hydrolysis is ka ulat hai: cells monomers ka bond paani shamil kar ke torte hain. Paani ka OH aik monomer se aur hydrogen doosre monomer se jurta hai. Misaal: maltose + paani se do glucose.

Ahmiyat: macromolecules ka tootna digestion aur cellular respiration mein zaroori hai jahan energy ke liye chhote molecules chahiye; paani ke H⁺ aur OH⁻ ions is mein hissa lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Cells break bonds between monomers by adding water to them

blocks.prompt:
4 Explain the solvent property of water. How do sodium chloride and glucose dissolve in it? (4 marks)
(Paani ki solvent (hal karne wali) property samjhayein. Sodium chloride aur glucose is mein kaise hal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Paani do khasoosiyaton ki wajah se bohat se maadde hal karta hai: molecules ki polarity aur hydrogen bonds banane ki salahiyat.

Polarity: paani ke molecule ke alag sire hain jin par juzvi charge hai; hydrogen juzvi positive aur oxygen juzvi negative. Aik molecule ka juzvi negative sira doosre ke juzvi positive sire ko kheenchta hai; yeh kamzor kashish hydrogen bond hai aur paani in ka jaal banata hai.

Paani ke molecules har us molecule ke gird jama ho jate hain jis par poora charge (ions) ya juzvi charge (polar molecules) ho:
Sodium chloride: paani mein NaCl Na⁺ aur Cl⁻ mein toot-ta hai; inhein paani ke molecules ke mukhalif polar sire gher lete hain (Figure 4.7).
Glucose: paani ke molecules glucose ke polar hydroxyl groups se hydrogen bonds banate hain, is liye glucose hal ho jata hai (Figure 4.8).

Is liye charged ya polar (hydrophilic) molecules jaise salts, sugars aur amino acids hal hote hain, magar non-polar (hydrophobic) lipids nahi. Mehlool mein ions aur molecules asaani se react karte hain, is liye paani metabolism ka medium hai.

book_ref.quote: The ability of water to dissolve a wide variety of substances is due to its two properties

blocks.prompt:
5 Water protects organisms from sudden temperature changes. Explain its high specific heat capacity and high heat of vaporization and how each benefits life. (4 marks)
(Paani jaandaaron ko temperature ki achanak tabdeeli se bachata hai. Is ki zyada specific heat capacity aur zyada heat of vaporization aur un ke faide bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Zyada specific heat capacity: specific heat capacity woh calories hain jo 1 g substance ka temperature 15 °C se 16 °C karne ke liye chahiye. Paani ki zyada hai, 4.184 J (zyada tar carbon compounds se do guna aur iron se nau guna). Jazb hui zyada tar heat paani ke molecules ke hydrogen bonds torne mein lagti hai; phir hi molecules azad harkat karte hain aur temperature barhta hai.
Faida: paani dheere garam hota hai aur thandi jagah der tak temperature rakhta hai, is liye jaandaaron ke andar aur bahar ke mahaul ka temperature stabilizer hai.

Zyada heat of vaporization: maae ko gas banane ke liye zaroori heat. Paani ki 574 Kcal/kg hai, yani 1 kg paani ko bukhaarat banane mein 574 Kcal. 1 litre mein se 2 ml bukhaarat banne par baqi 998 ml ka temperature 1 °C girta hai.
Faida: zameen ka temperature mo'tadil rehta hai aur transpiration aur paseene par paude aur janwar thande hote hain; jism ki satah se har gram bukhaarat 574 calories heat nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Water has a high specific heat capacity i.e., 4.184 Joules

blocks.prompt:
6 Explain the following properties of water and their importance for life: (i) cohesion and surface tension (ii) maximum density at 4 °C. (4 marks)
(Paani ki in properties aur zindagi ke liye un ki ahmiyat bayan karein: (i) cohesion aur surface tension (ii) 4 °C par zyada se zyada density.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Cohesion: hydrogen bonds paani ke molecules ko 'chipkaye' rakhte hain; aik hi qisam ke molecules ki yeh kashish cohesion hai aur paani mein yeh zyada hai. Paude jaron se patton tak paani aur ghiza le jane ke liye is par inhisar karte hain: patte se bukhaarat xylem vessels ke paani ko kheenchti hai aur cohesion ki wajah se yeh khinchao xylem se jaron tak pohanchta hai, is liye paani kashish-e-saql ke khilaf charhta hai.
Surface tension: hydrogen bonds paani ko zyada surface tension bhi dete hain; paani aisa lagta hai jaise is par na-nazar jhilli ho, is liye water-strider satah toray baghair paani par chalta hai.

(ii) 4 °C par zyada density: paani 4 °C par sab se ghana hai; is se neeche density kam hoti hai kyun ke hydrogen bonds molecules ko door rakhte hain. 0 °C par paani jamta hai aur barf maae paani se halki hoti hai kyun ke hydrogen bonding molecules ko mazeed door rakhti hai. Daryaon aur jheelon mein barf satah par ban kar tairti hai; yeh insulator ban kar neeche ke paani se heat nikalne nahi deti, is liye aabi jaandaar bach jate hain.

book_ref.quote: The cohesion of water is important for living world

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain (i) ionization of water and its importance (ii) hydrophobic exclusion and its role in cell membranes. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein: (i) paani ki ionization aur is ki ahmiyat (ii) hydrophobic exclusion aur cell membranes mein is ka kirdar.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Ionization: jab paani ke molecule ke atoms ke covalent bonds toot-te hain to paani hydrogen ions (H⁺) aur hydroxyl ions (OH⁻) mein ionize hota hai. Aam haalat mein yeh reaction ulat sakta hai aur tawazun (equilibrium) rehta hai. 25 °C par har 550 million mein se aik molecule ionize hota hai, is liye khalis paani mein H⁺ aur OH⁻ dono 10⁻⁷ moles/litre hain.
Ahmiyat: H⁺ aur OH⁻ cell ke bohat se reactions, jaise macromolecules ki hydrolysis, mein hissa lete hain. In ki nisbat medium ki acidity ya alkalinity (pH) tay karti hai; acids OH⁻ se jur kar H⁺ chhorte hain (acidic), bases H⁺ se jur kar OH⁻ chhorte hain (basic). pH biochemical reactions par asar karta hai aur enzymes khaas pH par behtareen kaam karte hain.

(ii) Hydrophobic exclusion: non-polar ya be-charge molecules hal nahi hote kyun ke paani un se hydrogen bonds nahi banata; paani mein dalne par paani unhein bahar kar deta hai aur woh aapas mein hydrophobic jor banate hain. Lipids hal nahi hote; paani se alag ho kar aapas mein mazboot jurte hain, is liye lipids cell membranes qaim rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: At normal conditions, this reaction is reversible and equilibrium is maintained

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe how glucose, galactose, fructose and ribose form ring structures in solution. Explain the alpha and beta forms of D-glucose. (4 marks)
(Bayan karein ke glucose, galactose, fructose aur ribose mehlool mein ring kaise banate hain. D-glucose ki alpha aur beta shaklon ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Mehlool mein zyada tar monosaccharides ring banate hain: aik hi sugar molecule ke do carbon atoms ke darmiyan oxygen-bridge banta hai (Figure 4.14).
Glucose: carbon 1 aur 5 ke darmiyan bridge, chhe kono wala ring (pyran).
Galactose: carbon 1 aur 5 ke darmiyan bridge, phir chhe kono wala pyran ring.
Fructose: carbon 2 aur 5 ke darmiyan bridge, paanch kono wala ring (furan).
Ribose: carbon 1 aur 4 ke darmiyan bridge, paanch kono wala furan ring.

Alpha aur beta D-glucose: D-glucose ki do shaklein sirf carbon 1 par OH group ki simt mein mukhtalif hain. α-D-glucose mein OH neeche aur β-D-glucose mein upar hai. Bohat se alpha-D-glucose jur kar starch aur bohat se beta-D-glucose jur kar cellulose banate hain.
Fischer projection sugar ko khuli zanjeer aur Haworth projection ring ki shakal mein dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: When in solution, most of the monosaccharides form ring structures

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the structure of starch and glycogen as storage polysaccharides. (4 marks)
(Zakheera polysaccharides ke taur par starch aur glycogen ki banawat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Starch: paudon ka zakheera polysaccharide. Yeh hal nahi hota aur plant cells mein starch granules banata hai; hal na hone se cells ka water potential nahi badalta, is liye cells osmosis se paani nahi lete. Starch in ka mixture hai:
Amylose: 1,4-glycosidic linkages wali glucose zanjeer; seedhi aur be-shaakh magar helix mein lipat-ti hai.
Amylopectin: 1,4-glycosidic linkages wali glucose zanjeer jis mein 1,6-glycosidic shaakhein hain; zyada sire hone se jaldi toot-ti hai.
Amylose aur amylopectin dono enzyme amylase se maltose mein toot-te hain, mukhtalif raftaar se.

Glycogen: janwaron ka zakheera polysaccharide, zyada tar muscles aur liver mein. Yeh amylopectin jaisa hai: 1,4-glycosidic linkages wali glucose zanjeer aur 1,6-glycosidic shaakhein. Bohat shaakhdaar hone ki wajah se yeh bohat jaldi glucose mein toot sakta hai.
Starch aur glycogen dono mein alpha-glucose hai (carbon 1 par OH neeche).

book_ref.quote: Starch is not a pure substance, but is a mixture of amylose and amylopectin

blocks.prompt:
10 Cellulose and starch are both chains of glucose. Explain how a small difference in glucose makes cellulose so different from starch in structure, strength and digestion. (4 marks)
(Cellulose aur starch dono glucose ki zanjeerein hain. Samjhayein ke glucose ka chhota sa farq cellulose ko banawat, mazbooti aur hazme mein starch se itna mukhtalif kaise banata hai.)
blocks.explanation: Cellulose sirf paudon mein, cell walls ke bare hisse ke taur par hai. Starch ki tarah yeh 1,4-glycosidic linkages wali glucose zanjeer hai magar glucose ke mukhtalif isomer ki.

book_ref.quote: This apparently tiny difference makes a huge difference in structure and properties

rows: Beta-glucose: carbon 1 par OH upar; har doosra glucose ulta
Alpha 1-4 polymer lipat kar granules banata hai
Beta 1-4 polymer seedhi zanjeerein banata hai
Saikron zanjeerein hydrogen bonds se microfibrils aur phir fibrils banati hain
Bohat mazboot aur sakht; plant cells, chhote paudon, kaghaz aur cotton ko mazbooti
Amylase se maltose mein toot-ta hai
Beta-glycosidic bond amylase se nahi toot-ta; cellulase chahiye; insaan hazam nahi kar sakte (dietary fibre); gaaye aur deemak aanton ke bacteria se

blocks.prompt:
11 Besides cellulose, several polysaccharides act as building materials. Describe chitin, pectin and lignin, agar and murein, giving where each is found. (4 marks)
(Cellulose ke ilawa kai polysaccharides tameeri maadde ka kaam karte hain. Chitin, pectin aur lignin, agar aur murein bayan karein aur har aik ki jagah batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Chitin: cellulose ki badli hui shakal. Cellulose ki tarah glucose ka polymer jis mein wahi linkage hai, magar har glucose mein nitrogen wala group shamil kiya gaya hai (Figure 4.22). Yeh kekron, lobsters aur keeron ke bairooni dhanche mein hai aur fungi ki cell wall banata hai. Bohat kam jaandaar ise hazam kar sakte hain.

Pectin aur lignin: tameeri maadde ke taur par polysaccharides jo plant cells ki cell walls mein hain.

Agar: red algae ki cell walls mein. Ghiza gaarhi karne aur labs mein bacteria aur fungi ugane ke medium ke taur par istemal.

Murein: sugar-peptide polymer jo prokaryotes ki cell walls mein hai.

book_ref.quote: Pectin and Lignin: They are also the polysaccharides used as building material

blocks.prompt:
12 Describe the general structure of an amino acid and explain what gives each amino acid its identity. Classify the amino acids of the human body into essential and non-essential, with examples. (4 marks)
(Amino acid ki aam banawat bayan karein aur batayein ke har amino acid ko us ki pehchaan kis se milti hai. Insaani jism ke amino acids ko essential aur non-essential mein misalon ke saath taqseem karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Banawat: amino acid proteins ka bunyaadi unit hai. Aik hi carbon (alpha carbon) se chaar groups jure hain: amino group (NH₂), carboxyl group (COOH), hydrogen (H) aur side group (R) (Figure 4.23).
Jaandaaron mein taqreeban 170 qisam ke amino acids hain; taqreeban 25 proteins bana sakte hain; zyada tar proteins 20 se bante hain.

Pehchaan: har amino acid ki pehchaan aur khaas chemical khasoosiyat us ke side group (R) se tay hoti hai jo alpha carbon se covalent bond se jura hai. Glycine mein R hydrogen atom aur alanine mein CH₃ hai (Figure 4.24).

Taqseem (20 mein se):
Non-essential (gyarah, jism khud banata hai): alanine, arginine, asparagine, aspartic acid, cysteine, glutamic acid, glutamine, glycine, proline, serine aur tyrosine.
Essential (nau, jism nahi bana sakta, ghiza se lene zaroori): methionine, valine, tryptophan, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, threonine, phenylalanine aur histidine (sirf bachon ke liye zaroori).

book_ref.quote: It is an organic molecule, in which four groups

blocks.prompt:
13 Proteins can be classified on the basis of their structure. Compare fibrous and globular proteins in detail, with examples. (4 marks)
(Proteins ko un ki banawat par taqseem kiya ja sakta hai. Fibrous aur globular proteins ka misalon ke saath tafseeli muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Proteins ko kaam (structural aur functional) par bhi baanta ja sakta hai magar tajveez-shuda taqseem structure par hai: fibrous aur globular proteins (Table 4.4).

book_ref.quote: We can describe the characteristics of both these classes by a comparison in table 4.4

rows: Salt, acid ya base mehlool aur aqueous alcohol mein hal
Mahaul ki tabdeeli se be-tarteeb ho jate hain
Silk fibre (resham ke keere aur makri ke jaale), actin (muscle cells), fibrin (khoon ka lothra), keratin (nakhun, baal, chonch, jild), collagen (connective tissue ka matrix)
Enzymes (biocatalysts), antibodies (antigens ke khilaf), kuch hormones (jism ki sargarmiyan control), haemoglobin (oxygen le jata hai)

blocks.prompt:
14 Proteins carry out virtually all activities of living organisms. Describe eight structural and functional roles of proteins, with an example of each. (4 marks)
(Proteins jaandaaron ki taqreeban tamam sargarmiyan anjaam dete hain. Proteins ke aath structural aur functional kirdar har aik ki misaal ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Membranes: proteins tamam plasma membranes ka ahem hissa hain; channel proteins maadde ki aamad-o-raft control karte hain, jaise neurons ka sodium-potassium pump Na⁺ aur K⁺ ki harkat control karta hai.
2. Banawat: fibrous proteins collagen aur keratin tarteeb se cartilage aur baal aur nakhun ki taqreeban poori banawat banate hain.
3. Enzymes: metabolism tez karte hain, jaise proteases proteins torte hain, polymerases polymers banate hain.
4. Hormones: kuch proteins ya peptides hain, jaise insulin khoon ki glucose control karta hai, antidiuretic hormone gurdon mein paani roknay ko barhata hai.
5. Muntaqili: haemoglobin aur myoglobin O₂ aur kuch CO₂ le jate hain; cytochromes electron transport chain mein electrons le jate hain; albumin khoon ki osmotic concentration qaim rakhta hai.
6. Khoon ka jamna: zakhm par fibrinogen fibrin mein badalta hai; fibrin reshe banata hai aur lothra banta hai.
7. Sukarna: actin aur myosin muscles sukarte hain; tubulin spindle fibres banata hai.
8. Difa: antibodies antigens ko pehchan kar un se jurti hain aur unhein be-zarar banati hain.
Mazeed, ion-binding proteins ions jama karte hain (ferritin iron, casein potassium aur calcium), aur repressors RNA ki tayyari rok kar gene ka amal control karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Proteins carry out virtually all activities of living organisms

blocks.prompt:
15 Describe the four structural levels of proteins and the bonds that maintain each level. (4 marks)
(Proteins ke chaar structural darje aur har darje ko qaim rakhne wale bonds bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Protein structure ke darje Figure 4.29 mein hain.

1. Primary structure: amino acids ki seedhi tarteeb, yani polypeptide chain mein amino acids ki tadaad aur tarteeb, jo peptide bonds se juri hai. Har protein ka khaas primary structure hai jo DNA mein nucleotides ki tarteeb se tay hota hai. Insulin ki do chains (alpha 21, beta 30 amino acids); haemoglobin mein do alpha (141 har aik) aur do beta (146 har aik) chains. Sirf aik tabdeeli (beta chain ki chhati jagah glutamic acid ki jagah valine) sickle cell haemoglobin banati hai.

2. Secondary structure: chain ke lipatne se alpha helix aur tah hone se pleated sheet banti hai. Dono qareebi amino acids ke amino aur carboxyl groups ke hydrogen bonds se qaim hain.

3. Tertiary structure: secondary structure mazeed mur kar pecheeda globular shakal banata hai jo ionic, hydrogen aur disulphide bonds se qaim hai. Hydrophobic (non-polar) amino acids andar chhup jate hain aur hydrophilic (polar) bahar paani ki taraf, jis se sab se mustahkam shakal banti hai.

4. Quaternary structure: tertiary structure wali do ya zyada polypeptide chains hydrophobic interactions, hydrogen bonds aur ionic bonds se juri rehti hain aur sab se pecheeda proteins banti hain.

book_ref.quote: The following are different levels at which proteins are built

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: primary = sirf tarteeb (moti ki maala), secondary = maala ka lipatna ya tah hona, tertiary = poori maala ka gola ban jana, quaternary = kai golon ka mil kar aik protein banna.

blocks.prompt:
16 Fatty acids decide the characteristics of acylglycerols. (i) Describe fatty acids and glycerol. (ii) Compare saturated and unsaturated fatty acids and explain why animal fats store more energy than plant oils. (4 marks)
(Fatty acids acylglycerols ki khasoosiyat tay karte hain. (i) Fatty acids aur glycerol bayan karein. (ii) Saturated aur unsaturated fatty acids ka muqabla karein aur batayein ke janwaron ki charbi paudon ke oils se zyada energy kyun rakhti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Acylglycerols fatty acids aur alcohol (glycerol) ke esters hain jo dehydration synthesis se bante hain (OH acid ke carboxyl group se, H alcohol ke -OH se). Triacylglycerols mein teen fatty acids aik glycerol se jure hain.
Glycerol: 3 carbon wala alcohol jis ke har carbon par hydroxyl group hai; is ke 3 carbons dhancha banate hain jis se teen fatty acids jurte hain.
Fatty acids: lambi hydrocarbon zanjeerein jin mein juft tadaad mein carbon (4-30) hain aur aakhir mein carboxyl (-COOH) group; janwaron mein seedhi, paudon mein shaakhdaar ya ring wali. Carbon atoms barhne se organic solvents mein solubility aur melting point barhte hain.

(ii) Muqabla table mein hai. Janwaron ki charbi mein saturated fatty acids aur is liye zyada C-H bonds hain; paudon ke oils mein unsaturated fatty acids aur kam C-H bonds. Energy C-H bonds mein jama hoti hai, is liye janwaron ki charbi mein zyada energy hai.

book_ref.quote: Fatty acids: These are responsible for all the characteristics of acylglycerols

rows: Zanjeer mein koi double bond nahi
Aik ya zyada carbon joron mein double bonds (zyada se zyada 6)
Andar ke tamam carbons par hydrogen
Double bonds kuch hydrogens ki jagah lete hain; kam hydrogen
Janwaron ki charbi mein; zyada C-H bonds
Paudon ke oils mein; kam C-H bonds; aik double bond = mono-unsaturated, zyada = poly-unsaturated

blocks.prompt:
17 Describe (i) steroids, with cholesterol and anabolic steroids as examples (ii) prostaglandins and their roles. (4 marks)
(Bayan karein: (i) steroids, cholesterol aur anabolic steroids ki misaal ke saath (ii) prostaglandins aur un ke kaam.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Steroids: woh lipids jin ka carbon dhancha mur kar chaar jure hue rings banata hai; sab ka aik hi pattern: teen chhe kono wale aur aik paanch kono wala ring.
Cholesterol janwaron ki cell membranes ka aam steroid hai; yeh membranes qaim rakhta hai, lipids ki muntaqili mein madad deta hai aur vitamin D, bile acids aur steroid hormones (mard aur aurat ke sex hormones, adrenal hormones, corticosteroids) ka precursor hai.
Anabolic steroids testosterone jaise banaye gaye steroids hain; yeh muscle aur haddi ka wazan barhate hain. 1950s mein aam anaemia ke ilaaj ke liye banaye gaye; kuch khiladiyon ne ghalat istemal kiya. Ab yeh mamnoo hain kyun ke gehra depression aur liver ka nuqsan jaise sakht jismani aur zehni masail dete hain.

(ii) Prostaglandins: badle hue fatty acids wale lipids jin ki non-polar dumein paanch carbon ring se juri hain. Yeh vertebrates ke bohat se tissues mein maqami chemical paigham-bar hain. Kuch smooth muscles ko sukarte aur dheela karte hain; kuch khoon ki naaliyon ko tang ya khula karte hain; yeh infection par sozish mein shamil hain. Aspirin prostaglandins ko rokti hai, is liye sozish, dard aur bukhaar kam karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Steroids are lipids whose carbon skeleton is bent to form four fused rings

blocks.prompt:
18 Describe the roles of lipids in the life of organisms. (4 marks)
(Jaandaaron ki zindagi mein lipids ke kirdar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Energy: lipids energy (ATP) ka ahem zariya aur sab se zyada energy wale ghizai ajza hain. Aik gram lipids 9.5 kilocalories dete hain, protein 5.6 aur carbohydrate 4.1. Acylglycerols zyada C-H bonds ki wajah se behtar energy store karte hain aur hal na hone se khaas jagahon par jama hote hain; jaandaar lambe zakheere ke liye glucose ko fats ya oils mein badalte hain.
2. Membranes: lipids tamam cell aur sub-cell membranes ka lazmi hissa hain (phosphatidyl choline jaise phospholipids lipid bilayer banate hain).
3. Vitamins ke carrier: yeh vitamins A, D, E aur K ko jazb karwate hain.
4. Fatty acids: lipids mukhtalif metabolisms ke liye zaroori fatty acids dete hain.
5. Gaddi: ahem aaza ko mechanical gaddi aur sahara dete hain.
6. Insulation: jild ke neeche charbi jism ko sakht temperature se bachati hai.
7. Steroids: cholesterol membranes qaim rakhta hai, lipids ki muntaqili mein madad deta hai aur vitamin D, bile acids aur steroid hormones ka precursor hai.
8. Hifazat: waxes hydrophobic hain aur phalon, patton aur janwaron ki jild par hifazati parat aur paani ki rukawat hain.

book_ref.quote: Lipids are important sources of energy (ATP)

blocks.prompt:
19 Compare DNA and RNA in their sugar, bases, number of strands, location and types. (4 marks)
(DNA aur RNA ka un ki sugar, bases, strands ki tadaad, jagah aur qismon mein muqabla karein.)

20 Nucleotides do more than build nucleic acids. (i) Describe ATP and NAD as nucleotides. (ii) Explain how DNA controls the activities of a cell through its genes. (4 marks)
(Nucleotides sirf nucleic acids nahi banate. (i) ATP aur NAD ko nucleotides ke taur par bayan karein. (ii) Samjhayein ke DNA apne genes ke zariye cell ki sargarmiyan kaise control karta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) ATP adenine ka triphosphate nucleotide hai: aik ribose sugar se teen phosphate groups jure hain. Yeh cell ki 'energy currency' hai; do phosphate groups aik aik kar ke alag kar ke ADP aur phir AMP banta hai aur energy deta hai.
NAD (Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide) co-enzyme hai; yeh cell ke oxidation-reduction reactions mein hydrogen qubool karta hai.

(ii) DNA tamam jaandaaron (kuch viruses ke siwa) ka moroosi maadda hai aur us mein woh 'program' hai jo cell ki tamam sargarmiyan chalata hai. Program genes ki shakal mein hai; gene DNA nucleotides ki tarteeb hai jo polypeptide ka code hai.
Tamam jaandaar genes ko aik hi tareeqe se parhte aur zahir karte hain, central dogma. Pehla, transcription: gene ki RNA copy ban kar maloomat DNA se RNA mein jati hai. Doosra, translation: RNA ki maloomat proteins banne ki rehnumai karti hai. Gene ON hone par transcribe aur translate ho kar khaas proteins banta hai; yun DNA cell ki khasoosiyat aur sargarmiyan control karta hai.
